name: io.github.DannyFiallo030503/mcp-frappe
title: Frappe MCP for developers
description: Create and edit Frappe DocTypes, customize forms, and sync a dev site with your app's files.

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Frappe site, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Site name sent as the Host header on a multi-site Bench

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the Frappe user (or use FRAPPE_USERNAME and FRAPPE_PASSWORD)

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret of the Frappe user

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Login user for password auth; defaults to Administrator

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_APPS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The Bench apps folder, for standard DocTypes and file exports

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: read, data, customize, developer (default: all)

environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: YES lists only the read tools; NO allows writes to a remote site
